summary: Read autonomy status during running verification cycles

delivery.outcome: Publish and deploy a read-only status snapshot available during bounded verification cycles (STARTER-021); preserve separately blocked automatic controller admission STARTER-020.
nonGoals: No source-execution admission or policy changes
No edits to foreign repositories or browser pages

architecture.decision: Keep the exclusive writer lock for cycles; query SQLite through a read-only connection for operator status. Validate configuration before and after snapshot and do not initialize state from reads.
architecture.rollback: Restore the prior deployed release, configuration and user unit from exact verified pre-update backups.

validation.evidence: Status snapshot works during a real held writer lock, before initialization, and on protected paths; concurrent cycles remain rejected.
Native gate and independent exact-head publication pass.
Merged runtime installed and live status returns during the systemd verification cycle.
